Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Bounty Systems Trailer
Take a look at the DMZ Bounty Systems Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, a first-person action shooter developed by Infinity Ward. text:
I Played 6 Hours of Phantom Blade Zero and Can’t Stop Thinking About It | IGN Preview
After half a day playing Phantom Blade Zero, it’s gone from mostly not on my radar to to the top of my wishlist this fall, and I truly cannot wait to dive back in later this month to see if it can deliver beyond those first handful of hours. At least for now, though, just about everything I’ve seen and played has made me more convinced that this is going to be one of the coolest action games of 2026. Previewed by Travis Northup

Prospice: Anomalous Logistics - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall 2026
Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Prospice: Anomalous Logistics, an atmospheric driving exploration game developed by Code Wakers. Players will explore an uncharted island warped by the remains of decaying gods, exploring its mysteries with your trusty off-road truck. Plot routes through treacherous terrain, keep remote outposts supplied, and dare to leave safety and your truck behind to uncover occult artifacts and forgotten truths. Prospice: Anomalous Logistics is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

Check out the Dave the Diver x Subnautica 2 trailer for this upcoming crossover between the RPG adventure game and the underwater survival adventure game. Dave takes his harpoon far from the Blue Hole and into an alien ocean where the locals aren't quite so welcoming. New depths, new creatures, and plenty Dave has never run into before.

Dave the Diver is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Nintendo Switch. The Dave the Diver x Subnautica 2 DLC will be available in early 2027.

text:
GTA 6 Reveals More Songs, Radio Stations, and Celebrity DJs - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar has revealed the radio stations that will fill the soundtrack of GTA 6, and the celebrities that will host them. Among the real-world stars joining the line-up are Morgan Wallen and Lana Del Rey who will host Back Country Radio, Bad Bunny hosting Latin music station Cocoteo FM, pop-centric Flash FM hosted by Robyn, and more. In other news, Xbox has announced XP, a new division of the company that will bring together their expansive IP for use in movies, TV shows, live events, and more. Microsoft has already seen success in the movies and TV space with the Minecraft movie and the Fallout series on Prime Video. Upcoming releases include the Call of Duty from Taylor Sheridan and Peter Berg, and the Minecraft Squared sequel.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture - Official Trailer | NYCC 2026
Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture is a raunchy new take on a cozy farming genre – if those crops were akin to Jay and Silent Bob’s specific cultural tastes. The game is a love letter to filmmaker Kevin Smith’s beloved cult classic characters – within the digital realm. Players will build, cultivate and expand their operation, interact with familiar faces, and experience an original story featuring Kevin Smith's iconic characters.

Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture is currently heading toward its playtesting phase of production, with an expected release in late Spring 2027 on Steam/PC. A console release is also slated for 2027.
